data.exact_reserve_text: The 2017 result, net improvement in prior years reserve of $17.7 (2016: $77.0), consistent with gross premiums written partially offset by reinsurance.

named_events.loss_description: Listed in the catastrophe exposures table as a named event exposure for the year.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780 recorded a small net release on prior underwriting years at the 2017 year-end. Using the gross claims development table (claims development triangle) the calculated gross prior-year development is a modest release of approximately 1.6 (USD millions), driven by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries; the Managing Agent narrative also refers to a net improvement on prior years of $17.7m (net of reinsurance). The development is concentrated in older underwriting years (2011-2015).
raw_causal_phrases: net improvement in prior years reserve of $17.7
data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement was not explicitly stated as a single 'Insurance liabilities' (gross) figure in the movement note visible; the Managing Agent text quotes a NET prior-year improvement of $17.7m. A gross prior-year movement was computed from the published GROSS claims development triangle (page 29) as a fallback, giving approx -1.6 (release). Premium mix was inferred from the segmental table that showed a split of Direct insurance and Reinsurance acceptances (amounts 73.5 and 197.7) - the printed regulatory class breakdown was partially unclear in the scanned images. Named catastrophe exposures are listed in the catastrophe exposures table (page 26) but quantified losses for syndicate-specific net loss were not given in the text scanned. Numbers are in the report's native currency USD (millions).
